tools.name: yousign_list_signature_requests
tools.description: List signature requests (contracts sent for e-signature) with their status, name, signers count and dates. Filter by status, name text, workspace or external id. Use the returned next_cursor to read more. Yousign API: GET /signature_requests.

tools.name: yousign_get_signature_request
tools.description: Get one signature request with its status, dates, delivery mode, signers, approvers and labels. Yousign API: GET /signature_requests/{id}.

tools.name: yousign_list_signers
tools.description: List the signers of a signature request with each signer's status (notified, signed, declined and so on) and signature level. Yousign API: GET /signature_requests/{id}/signers.

tools.name: yousign_get_signer
tools.description: Get one signer of a signature request: name, email, status and signature details. Yousign API: GET /signature_requests/{id}/signers/{signerId}.

tools.name: yousign_list_documents
tools.description: List the documents attached to a signature request (name, id, page count, status). The file content is not returned. Yousign API: GET /signature_requests/{id}/documents.

tools.name: yousign_get_signer_audit_trail
tools.description: Get the audit trail (JSON) of one signer: the events of the signing process with their times. Only possible once the signer has signed. Yousign API: GET /signature_requests/{id}/signers/{signerId}/audit_trails.

tools.name: yousign_list_templates
tools.description: List the templates of the organization. A template holds documents and fields that a new signature request can start from. Yousign API: GET /templates.

tools.name: yousign_get_template
tools.description: Get one template: its name, documents and fields. Yousign API: GET /templates/{id}.

tools.name: yousign_list_workspaces
tools.description: List the workspaces of the organization. Use a workspace id to filter signature requests or to create one in that workspace. Yousign API: GET /workspaces.

tools.name: yousign_create_signature_request
tools.description: Create a new signature request as a DRAFT. It sends nothing: add signers, then activate it to send the emails. Optionally start from a template_id. Yousign API: POST /signature_requests.

tools.name: yousign_add_signer
tools.description: Add a signer to a draft signature request. The signer gets no email until the request is activated. Yousign API: POST /signature_requests/{id}/signers.

tools.name: yousign_activate_signature_request
tools.description: Activate a draft signature request. This SENDS the signing emails to every signer. Call only after the user confirms the signers and the document. Yousign API: POST /signature_requests/{id}/activate.

tools.name: yousign_send_signer_reminder
tools.description: Send a reminder email to one signer who has not signed yet. Sends an email to a real person. Yousign API: POST /signature_requests/{id}/signers/{signerId}/send_reminder.

tools.name: yousign_cancel_signature_request
tools.description: Cancel a signature request. Signers can no longer sign it. Use it only when the user asks to cancel. Yousign API: POST /signature_requests/{id}/cancel.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: yousign_get_signer · Private data: yousign_list_documents, yousign_list_templates, yousign_get_template, yousign_activate_signature_request · Public sink: yousign_get_signer, yousign_create_signature_request, yousign_add_signer, yousign_activate_signature_request, yousign_send_signer_reminder, yousign_cancel_signature_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: yousign_get_signer · Private data: yousign_list_documents, yousign_list_templates, yousign_get_template, yousign_activate_signature_request · Public sink: yousign_get_signer, yousign_create_signature_request, yousign_add_signer, yousign_activate_signature_request, yousign_send_signer_reminder, yousign_cancel_signature_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
